# Freedoom 0.13.0

`freedoom1.wad` (Phase 1) and `freedoom2.wad` (Phase 2) from the official
release https://github.com/freedoom/freedoom/releases/tag/v0.13.0
(`freedoom-0.13.0.zip`, sha256
`3f9b264f3e3ce503b4fb7f6bdcb1f419d93c7b546f4df3e874dd878db9688f59`).
Shipped in the UZDoom NX2 package so it is playable out of the box.

Licence: BSD-style, see `COPYING.txt`; credits in `CREDITS.txt` and
`CREDITS-MUSIC.txt`. `SHA256SUMS.txt` is checked by `scripts/build.sh`.
